theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma sits at rank 4 with high durability (0.77), trend hurst, strongest eligible breadth (0.778), and is one of the few trend-gate eligible themes with genuine trend health. Crowding_z 1.56 is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The lean rests on the validated absolute-trend gate (staying power) plus durability/cohesion, not on momentum alpha.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.56 with crowded=true and rank 4 means the theme is already well-owned; cross-sectional momentum rank carries ~0 forward edge, so the overweight may simply be chasing a coincident defensive bid that mean-reverts if the macro backdrop shifts (unscheduled_share 1.0 suggests headline-driven chop, not trend).

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Rank 15 with the single highest durability_bar (0.83) among all eligible themes, trend hurst, and strong breadth (0.889). It is NOT crowded (crowded=false, crowding_z 0.91), making it a cleaner trend-gate-eligible defensive lean than Big Pharma on a crowding-adjusted basis. The edge claim is staying-power only, per the validated absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Rank 15 means momentum/focus is NOT concentrated here; the theme scores low on the attention lens. Low dir_accuracy (0.424) on the track record argues for a very small directional commitment.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Headline theme (weight 0.25, val_state confirming), rank 2, trend-gate eligible, NOT crowded, with breadth 0.682. This is the highest-ranked theme that is simultaneously eligible, not crowded, and showing confirming value state. However hurst_tag=mixed (not trend) tempers conviction.
